description: On-chain resolution of ONE Polymarket market, keyed by its `condition_id` (the market's 0x... hex id from polymarket_markets or polymarket_market_detail; an outcome token id matches nothing here). Returns [] or one row {condition_id, slug, question, outcomes, winning_index, winning_outcome, winning_token_id, token_ids, payouts, resolved_block, resolved_ts_ms (epoch ms), market_known}. market_known false means the market list has no row for it: slug, question, outcomes, token_ids, winning_outcome and winning_token_id are then empty, the on-chain fields still exact. [] means the chain has not resolved this condition, NOT that the market is open: a market can be cancelled or voided with no on-chain resolution, so read polymarket_market_detail for the market's own status.

condition_id.description: Required. The market's condition id (0x-prefixed hex).
